evals.expected_behavior: Tab through the page, add :focus-visible styles in the accent color, replace outline: none in mega-guitar/styles.css, and make drop zones reachable via a real file input or button.
evals.expected_output: Keyboard and focus fixes with files changed and manual keyboard verification steps.

evals.prompt: den röda texten i Mega Now är svårläst, kolla kontrasten
evals.expected_behavior: Run the contrast check for --red on --black, report the 3.87:1 ratio, and propose a color or usage change that reaches 4.5:1 for text.

evals.expected_behavior: Put the changing status text in an element with role=status or aria-live=polite and make sure state is not signaled by color alone.
